validation_notes: Since late June, VET has been trading in a tight, flat horizontal range between roughly 0.0043 and 0.0050 with no clear convergence — highs and lows are both roughly flat, not narrowing into an apex. This looks more like a sideways consolidation/rectangle than a descending triangle. A descending triangle requires a clearly falling upper trendline (lower highs) with a flat support; here the recent highs (Jul 20 onward) are roughly flat to slightly rising, not descending. The algorithm likely mistook the prior steep downtrend (May-June) into the current flat base as the 'descending' leg, but that decline already fully played out and price has stabilized into consolidation, not an active converging triangle. Not enough evidence of two converging trendlines with multiple respected touches to call this a credible triangle.
